==Instructions==
This template is meant to be used as part of the "description=" parameter of the {{Tl|Information}} template used on File pages, to provide a transliteration of [[Aurebesh]] (or other scripts) formatted in similar way that on the image itself.

==Example==
<code>{{Translit|<nowiki>{{Translit|</nowiki>The grand
Coruscant
theatre
presents

Theepa

Live in
concert.
on her
hyperdrive
tour.

This
weekend
only.
Don't miss it!<nowiki>}}</nowiki>}}</code>

Results in:

{{Translit|The grand
Coruscant
theatre
presents

Theepa

Live in
concert.
on her
hyperdrive
tour.

This
weekend
only.
Don't miss it!}}
